The expected weight was mu, where mu followed a power law #> in frond count relative to the geometric mean frond count (4.48), in which #> alpha is the expected weight at the geometric mean frond count and #> fronds_slope the allometric exponent. The log of alpha varied by site, by #> year, and by site:year. Regularising priors were placed on all parameters #> (see the notation form for the prior arguments).
